text:
jen: Quick follow-up from today

alex: Summary request: single-line fallback order we can share with customers?

maria: Short: in-region warm lane -> same-region alternate SKU (quantized) -> nearest healthy region -> reserved/dedicated pool (if committed) -> model-family downgrade only if opted-in.

kyle: Routing priority tiebreakers: capacity_hint > customer_tier > latency_slo > cost_pref.

jen: What about billing if we switch mid-request?

rebecca: Billing rule: tokens billed to the model that generated them. Console will show per-request model/token split.

sam: Any mitigation to avoid jarring outputs when we fallback mid-stream?

maria: We try KV/prefix cache reuse for compatible families. If incompatible, we do a short continuation handoff prompt and set conservative sampling on fallback. Responses tagged with metadata so clients can flag them.

tia: Will we publish post-spike metrics? customers asked for transparency.

alex: Yes for incident-sized spikes we’ll publish percent routed to fallback, median latency delta, and a short timeline. No sensitive data.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: region-fallback canary adjusted by @kyle from 20% -> 50% during ramp.

jen: Action items: kyle to draft public FAQ blurb on billing & fallbacks; maria to write handoff doc; rebecca to confirm billing UI shows per-model splits. I’ll coordinate a short customer note with comms. Drop edge cases here.
